title: Learning Personalized Alignment in Evaluating Open-ended Text Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's tendency to assign higher scores or inappropriate preference to text it has memorized from pre-training (contamination). This is measured by comparing evaluation performance on raw datasets versus anonymized and summarized datasets, and calculating a 'Bias Memorized' metric based on how often the model favors the memorized plot over the ground truth.

Measuring the percentage of times the model inappropriately favors the first answer in a pairwise comparison (Bias First), evaluated by swapping the order of the two inputs and checking consistency against the ground truth.
